title: Storm Sorceress
description: A white-haired woman in ornate golden and white attire floats above a stormy sea, wielding a glowing blue staff in one hand while summoning a swirling vortex of orange and blue energy with the other. Below her, sailing ships are tossed by turbulent waves amid a dark, aurora-filled night sky encircled by glowing runes and ethereal hands.
prompt: A beautiful white-haired sorceress with long flowing braids floats dynamically above a stormy ocean at night, wearing ornate white and gold fantasy attire, holding a tall glowing blue magical staff in one hand while her other hand summons a swirling orange and blue energy vortex, surrounded by glowing magical runes and ethereal hands in the sky, turbulent waves crashing against old wooden sailing ships below, dramatic aurora borealis lighting the dark blue sky, highly detailed fantasy scene
